pr.title: Put a drawer's discuss, dismiss, and snooze on one line, and capitalize the actions
pr.head: c50e2e404ab267edaaa26b8e5224b8737fcb70c0

summary: Projector's panel lists open pull requests and inbox items (questions, notices, and requests an agent posts) above the Claude Code prompt. Opening a line shows its drawer: the item's detail, its options on the digits 1 to 5, and then its actions on 6 to 9.

Before this change, each action took its own line and named the item's kind in lowercase, such as 7: discuss question, 8: dismiss question, and 9: snooze question. Those lines took as much height as the options and read unlike them, since options are capitalized.

This change puts Discuss, Dismiss, and Snooze side by side on the drawer's last line, as 7: Discuss 8: Dismiss 9: Snooze, and capitalizes every action. I don't understand keeps its own line on 6 above them. Restore, Unsnooze, and Cancel take the same place on the same digits. A pull request's drawer gets the same row, 7: Discuss 8: Dismiss, and its confirmation reads 8: Yes, dismiss it 9: No, keep it. The digits, Button keys, and press handlers stay the same, so only the drawer's look changes.

cards.html:

groups.title: The drawer draws its actions in one row
groups.kicker: How the panel lays out an item's and a pull request's actions
intro: The panel draws each action as a plain Button, which Claude Code renders as its hotkey, a colon, and the label, such as 7: Discuss. Before, a helper called drawLines returned those Buttons as siblings in the drawer's column, so each took a line.

A new helper, drawActions, wraps the same Buttons in a Box with flexDirection="row" and a two-column gap, keyed actions:<id>. An item's drawer now draws I don't understand through drawLines on its own line, then the other actions through drawActions. While snooze asks how long, the lengths take the options' place through drawLines, and Cancel moves into the row. A pull request's drawer draws its two actions, or its confirmation, through drawActions.

checks.text: Every Button keeps its key, hotkey, and order in the tree, so the focus ring, which carry and toggle move by key, behaves as before. The full claude plugin test . suite passes at this head, including the keyboard-ring tests for snooze, cancel, and a pull request's dismiss confirmation.

files.note: Adds drawActions, splits I don't understand from the other actions, pulls Cancel out of the snooze lengths, and capitalizes every action label.

checks.text: The row Box sets no flexWrap. In a terminal too narrow for the whole row, about 33 columns past the drawer's indent for an item and about 34 past the label column for a pull request's confirmation, its Buttons share the width instead of each wrapping on a line of its own. No live run measured this.
restore now takes its label as an argument, so Restore and Unsnooze no longer append the item's kind.

groups.title: Tests read the row and the new labels
groups.kicker: The panel tests check the row's layout and every label
intro: The panel tests run the hooks module against a simulated Claude Code engine and inspect the element tree the panel returns. A new helper, rowOf, finds an actions: Box, checks that it lays out as a row, and lists its Buttons with their hotkeys and labels. The drawer-layout assertions now expect one actions: entry where they expected a line per action, and every label assertion expects the capitalized text.

checks.text: With the base hooks/register.tsx, 10 panel tests fail. With the new labels but one action per line, the two layout tests fail: the pull request drawer test and the drawer-actions test. So the tests catch both the old labels and the old layout.

files.note: Adds rowOf, renames the drawer-actions test, and updates every expected label and drawer row.

groups.title: Docs describe the new row and labels
groups.kicker: The panel guide and the CLI reference use the new labels
intro: docs/plugins.md describes the panel. Its drawer examples now end with the one-line row, and its prose names every action by its capitalized label. docs/cli.md changes one sentence about Restore and Unsnooze. The completed plans under docs/projects/inbox/ keep the old labels, because a completed plan records what was built at the time.

files.note: Updates the drawer examples, the action list, the keyboard section, and every action label.

checks.text: This sentence says the options and the actions form one list under the options. The review suggests "The actions follow the options after a blank line:" instead.

files.note: Capitalizes Restore and Unsnooze in the inbox restore section.
